y-m-72-10.material: Le yimodeli ezenza lula urhwebo lwemihla ngemihla lohlobo olunye lwesiqhamo kwintengiso yommelwane zibe ziintetho ezithe tye. Ixabiso P liku-천원 kwinto nganye, ubuninzi obufunwayo yi-Qd = 100 − 2P, yaye ubuninzi obunikezelwayo yi-Qs = −20 + 4P (izinto). Urhwebo lwenzeka kwixabiso apho ubuninzi obufunwayo bulingana nobuninzi obunikezelwayo (ulungelelwano). Urhulumente wabeka irhafu eyi-6천원 kwinto nganye kumthengisi. Umthengi uhlawula ixabiso P, yaye umthengisi ufumana i-P−6, nto leyo esalayo emva kokuhlawula irhafu ye-6. USeoyun wasombulula ngolu hlobo lungezantsi, ngengcamango yokuba 'nokuba umthengisi uhlawuliswa irhafu, ixabiso elihlawulwa ngumthengi linyuka ngomlinganiselo werhafu'.

Umgaqo wokuba urhwebo lwenzeka kwixabiso apho ubuninzi obufunwayo bulingana nobuninzi obunikezelwayo unikwa kwizinto. Lo msebenzi ukwinqanaba elinye ngaphezu kobunzima bokuqalisa.

Emva kwerhafu, umthengisi ufumana i-P−6, ngoko ubuninzi obunikezelwayo bungu-−20+4(P−6), kwaye ukusombulula 100−2P = −20+4(P−6) kunika P = 24 nobuninzi bokurhweba obungu-52. - Inxalenye ngaphezulu kwe-8,000만원: 30%

y-m-72-12.title: Itheyibhile yeNzuzo yeeVenkile ezimbini eziBeka amaXabiso
y-m-72-12.topic: Ukhuphiswano lwamaxabiso phakathi kweevenkile ezimbini (ukufunda nokuyila itheyibhile yenzuzo)
y-m-72-12.goal: Qinisekisa ngetheyibhile yenzuzo ukuba nokuba ukhetho olunye lungcono nokuba omnye wenzani, ukuba bobabini bayenza kunye inokuba mbi kuye wonke umntu, yila wena itheyibhile yenzuzo enolwakhiwo olufanayo, uze uthi izinto zitshintsha njani xa kuphindwa, ngemiqathango.
y-m-72-12.material:
Ivenkile yeesnaki X nevenkile yeesnaki Y zisesitratweni esinye, yaye kwiveki enye nganye inokukhetha 'ukugcina' okanye 'ukunciphisa' ixabiso layo. Iivenkile ezimbini zigqiba ngaxeshanye yaye azazi ukhetho lomnye komnye. (Ukuvumelana ngamaxabiso kwangaphambili (ukudibana) kuhlala kuvaliwe ngumthetho, ngoko akufakwanga kulo msebenzi.) Inzuzo yeveki enye (만원; ucwangciso yinzuzo ka-X, inzuzo ka-Y) imi ngolu hlobo.
X igcina · Y igcina: (60, 60)
X inciphisa · Y igcina: (80, 30)
X igcina · Y inciphisa: (30, 80)
X inciphisa · Y inciphisa: (40, 40)
(Funda: ukuba X inciphisa kwaye Y igcina, X ifumana i-80만원 kwaye Y ifumana i-30만원.)
y-m-72-12.thinking.0: Ukufunda itheyibhile nokuthelekisa ngokhetho ngalunye lomnye
y-m-72-12.thinking.1: Ukwenza umzekelo wolwakhiwo olufanayo phantsi kwemiqathango
y-m-72-12.thinking.2: Ukuchaza umahluko phakathi kwemeko yexesha elinye nemeko ephindiweyo, ngemiqathango
y-m-72-12.prereq.0: (Ingcamango yomsebenzi) 'Economic Mathematics' kuthathelwa ekuhleni ukuba sisifundo sokukhetha sesikolo samabanga aphezulu esikhethwa emva kokufunda iziseko zamanani, iintetho nemisebenzi. I-H1/H2 ziileyibhile zobunzima kunye nenqanaba lenkxaso kuphela kulo msebenzi wemveliso; azithethi ukuba iMinistry of Education ibela isifundo kwibanga elithile. Amava okufunda itheyibhile, ukuthelekisa ubungakanani nokujonga iimeko zokungalingani (malunga nemathematika yesikolo samabanga aphezulu). Lo msebenzi ungenyathelo elinye ngaphezu kobunzima bokuqala.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.prompt: Cinga ngokwembono yevenkile X. Nokuba ivenkile Y ikhetha ntoni (ukugcina okanye ukwehlisa), luluphi ukhetho olungcono kwi-X?
y-m-72-12.s.s1.hint.0: Xa i-Y igcina, fumana amaxabiso amabini enzuzo ye-X kwitheyibhile uwathelekise.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana kwakhona amaxabiso amabini enzuzo ye-X xa i-Y iyehlisa uwathelekise, uze ujonge ukuba iziphumo zoqhathaniso lwamabini ziyafana na.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.a: Ukuba i-Y igcina ixabiso layo, ukwehlisa kungcono, kwaye ukuba i-Y iyehlisa, ukugcina kungcono.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.a: Xa i-Y iyehlisa, i-X ifumana i-30 ukuba igcina kwaye i-40 ukuba iyehlisa. Phinda ufunde loo meko kwitheyibhile.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.b: Ukwehlisa kungcono nokuba i-Y ikhetha ntoni. Kuyo yonke imeko inzuzo yokwehlisa inkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.b: Xa i-Y igcina, ukwehlisa kwe-X kunika i-80, enkulu kuneyi-60 yokugcina, kwaye xa i-Y iyehlisa, ukwehlisa kwe-X kunika i-40, enkulu kuneyi-30 yokugcina.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.c: Ukugcina kungcono nokuba i-Y ikhetha ntoni. Ukuba zombini ziyagcina, yi-60, eyona inkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.c: I-60 xa zombini zigcina yile ifunyanwa yi-X kunye ne-Y kunye. Ukuba i-Y iyehlisa, i-X inokufumana i-30 kuphela ngokugcina.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.d: Itheyibhile yodwa ayinakuxela ukuba ixhomekeke kukhetho lwe-Y na.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba ufunda itheyibhile ngokwahlula ukhetho lwe-Y lube ngamatyala amabini, unokubona kwelinye ukuba ngowuphi ukhetho unika i-X inzuzo enkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.explain: Ukuba i-Y igcina, ukwehlisa kwe-X (80) kukhulu kunokugcina (60), kwaye ukuba i-Y iyehlisa, ukwehlisa kwe-X (40) kukhulu kunokugcina (30). Nokuba i-Y yenza ntoni, ukwehlisa kungcono, ngoko i-X ifuna ukukhetha ukwehlisa. I-Y inesakhiwo esifanayo, ngoko ukuba zombini ziyehlisa yi-(40, 40), nangona ukugcina zombini kwakunika i-(60, 60) enkulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.prompt: Zenzele enye itheyibhile yeenzuzo enesakhiwo esifanayo nesingasentla. I-T yinzuzo ye-X xa i-X kuphela iyehlisa, i-R xa zombini zigcina, i-P xa zombini ziyehlisa, kwaye i-S xa i-X kuphela igcina (i-Y kuphela iyehlisa). Ukugcina isakhiwo sebali, kufuneka T > R > P > S, kwaye isixa senzuzo nelahleko yokuba icala elinye liyehlisa (T+S) kufuneka sibe sincinci kunamaxesha amabini enzuzo yokuba zombini zigcina (2R). Yenza iiseti ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zamaxabiso amane ahlukileyo kwitheyibhile engasentla. (Ii-integer ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-100)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala bhala ulandelelwano lobungakanani bamanani amane kwitheyibhile engasentla.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.1: Tshintsha amanani ugcina ulandelelwano, uze ujonge imeko yokugqibela (2R ngokuchasene ne-T+S) ngokuyibala wena.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.T: Inzuzo ye-X xa i-X kuphela iyehlisa (T)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.S: Inzuzo ye-X xa i-X kuphela igcina (S)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Amaxabiso amane ziiinteger ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda wenze amaxabiso amane abe ziiinteger ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Inzuzo T yokwehlisa wedwa inkulu kuneyi-R yokuba zombini zigcina.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c2: I-T ayikhulu kune-R. Xa enye igcina, ukwehlisa kufuneka kube nenzuzo ngakumbi.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c3: Ukuba zombini zigcina (R) kukhulu kunokuba zombini ziyehlisa (P).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c3: I-R ayikhulu kune-P. Ukuba zombini ziyehlisa, zombini kufuneka zibe mbi ngakumbi.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c4: Ukuba zombini ziyehlisa (P) kukhulu kunokugcina yedwa (S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c4: I-P ayikhulu kune-S. Xa enye iyehlisa, ukwehlisa kufuneka kube nenzuzo ngakumbi nako.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c5: Isixa xa zombini zigcina (2R) sikhulu kunesixa xa enye kuphela iyehlisa (T+S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c5: I-2R ayikhulu kune-T+S. Isixa xa zombini zigcina kufuneka sibe sikhulu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c6: Ngamanani afanayo netheyibhile engasentla. Yenza ngamanani ahlukeneyo.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.explain: Ukuba T>R>P>S njengakwi-(70, 50, 20, 10) kwaye 2R=100 inkulu kune-T+S=80, isakhiwo sebali siyafana. Kwesi sakhiwo ivenkile nganye ifumana inzuzo ngokukhetha ukwehlisa, kodwa ukuba zombini ziyehlisa, inzuzo incinci kunokuba zombini bezigcinile.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba ezi venkile zimbini azikhuphisani kanye kuphela kodwa ziqhubeka nokukhuphisana veki nganye, ingaba isiphelo singatshintsha? Bhala, ngezizathu, phantsi kweemeko ezithile ukuba singatshintsha kwaye njani (okanye ukuba asinakutshintsha).
y-m-72-12.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ukhetho lwakho lwale veki lungatshintsha na xa ufunda ukuba enye ivenkile iyehlisile kwiveki edlulileyo.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa indlela 'enye iya kuphendula njani ukuba ndiyehlisa?' ehluka ngayo xa ukhuphisana kanye kuphela nokuqhubeka nokukhuphisana.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndicinge ukuba xa kuphindaphindwa unokugqiba ngokujonga ukhetho lwangaphambili lwenye?
y-m-72-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndibhale ngokukhethekileyo iimeko apho isiphelo singatshintsha khona (impendulo yenye, ukuthembana njalo njalo)?
y-m-72-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ndicinge ukuba kunokubakho amatyala apho akutshintshi (njengokuba iveki yokugqibela ilungisiwe)?
y-m-72-12.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba baqhubeka nokukhuphisana veki nganye, banokujonga ukuba enye iyehlisile kwiveki edlulileyo baze bayehlise kunye kwiveki elandelayo, ngoko ukugcina zombini kunokuqhubeka, okanye ukwehlisa ngokuhlangeneyo kunokuthi kuzinze. Ngoko isiphelo sinokutshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwimpendulo yenye.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba kunjalo kanye kuphela, ukwehlisa kungcono, kodwa ukuba kuphindwa kwiiveki ezininzi enye inokuphindezela kwaye iinzuzo zinokwehla, ngoko usenokukhetha ukugcina. Kodwa ke, ukuba zombini ziyazi ukuba iveki yokugqibela ilungisiwe, ziya kwehlisa kwiveki yokugqibela, ngoko isiphelo sinokutshintsha kwakhona.
y-m-72-12.s.s3.model.2: Ukuba badibana amaxesha amaninzi, ukuthembana kuyakhula, kwaye ukuba ndiyehlisa, enye nayo inokuyehlisa, ngoko ukugcina ixabiso kunokuba nenzuzo ngakumbi.
